title: 第604章 分身第603章 修复千灵幻面
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 画面戛然而止。
巫未央捏着千灵幻面，眼前还花白一片，意识已经反应过来了。
千灵幻面，千灵幻面，千灵。
原来是这个意思。
这不只是一面可以变换容貌的面具，还是可以操控他人的面具。
此时视野已经差不多恢复正常，巫未央看向一旁的狐狸头骨，看到上面的彩绘时，没有了先前的欣赏，全是惊悚。
回味画面各处细节，巫未央猜测千灵幻面的炼器师或者说上一任主人是个女子，她不知是何原因，惹到了不少妖族，遭遇追杀，然后用千灵幻面控制了它们，但最后，她应该还是被杀了。
千灵幻面也被毁，然后不知为何流到了鸿蒙大陆，青云宗只收藏了宝石。
巫未央回忆当初卖她面具的摊主，是个再寻常不过的散修，对方说面具也是他从另一处买来的，只知名唤千灵幻面，不知是谁炼制，他本以为能修一修，再高价卖出去，可惜完全没有修的可能，加之他家底不丰，他舍不得将这么贵的面具留为己用，只能忍痛再卖掉。
千灵幻面虽然能够屏蔽化神修士的探知，可是在很多散修看来，他们认为用不上这么好的，毕竟化神修士可不是到处跑的存在，一辈子都没有可能亲身接触，更不要说产生交际怨恨，需要改头换面避着。
如果不是对千灵幻面的器纹感兴趣，巫未央当初也不会将它买下，毕竟行走江湖，改头换面的灵器法术多得很。
巫未央垂眸看向手中的千灵幻面，它已经焕然一新，七枚宝石稳稳当当镶嵌在眉峰处，边缘的焦黑也浅淡很多。
修复之后，它已经成为了一枚低阶灵宝。
幻面的能更强了一些，具体展现在更难察觉了。
而另一个千灵的功能，巫未央私心里，不喜欢操控活人为自己所用的感觉。
她看着千灵幻面，微微沉思，倏地眼眸亮了一下，进入竹箫空间。
巫未央直奔自己的灵石矿山，看着上面齐刷刷的玉俑傀儡，举起了千灵幻面。
心底难得有一丝紧张，她回忆着画面中的繁杂法印，细细琢磨后意识到那应该是一种禁制，她站在原地领悟半晌，才尝试着对千灵幻面使出。
灵光射出，在巫未央期待的目光下，覆盖在一众玉俑傀儡面上。
光芒散去，玉制的面孔泛出彩光。
巫未央激动了一下，才将千灵幻面戴上，一瞬间，温热的灵波拂过脸庞，识海中闪现了数道印记。
神识触动印记时，玉俑傀儡的身影浮现。
巫未央很快就弄清楚如何通过禁制印记操控玉俑傀儡。
只操控一具傀儡，自然顺手，但是想要操控数十上百具傀儡，那就难度就飙升了。
不过她的玉俑傀儡本就布置了同行术，她现在只要操控那只具备自觉行动的玉俑傀儡，就能让所有傀儡一块行动。
巫未央十分激动地玩了半天。
可惜玉俑傀儡炼制时就是奔着挖矿去的，难以改造成战斗傀儡。
想到这，巫未央找到了在花田里惬意采蜜的冬酿。
差点忘了，冬酿的皮毛已经长得差不多了。
巫未央眼神火热，冬酿懵懵懂懂转过身，然后就被逮住了。
content_en:
The scene stopped abruptly.
Wu Weiyang pinched Qianling's illusory face, her eyes were still gray, and her consciousness had already come to her senses.
The phantom of a thousand spirits, the phantom of a thousand spirits, the phantom of a thousand spirits.
That’s what it meant.
This is not only a mask that can change your appearance, but also a mask that can control others.
At this time, the field of vision had almost returned to normal. Wu Weiyang looked at the fox skull aside. When he saw the paintings on it, he lost his previous appreciation and was filled with horror.
After recalling the details in the picture, Wu Weiyang guessed that the refiner or the previous owner of the Thousand Spirits Phantom was a woman. For some unknown reason, she provoked many demon clans, was hunted down, and then used the Thousand Spirits Phantom to control them, but in the end, she should have been killed.
The Thousand Spirits Phantom was also destroyed, and then flowed to Hongmeng Continent for unknown reasons. The Qingyun Sect only collected gems.
Wu Weiyang recalled that the stall owner who sold her mask was an ordinary casual cultivator. The other party said that he also bought the mask from another place. He only called the Thousand Spirits Phantom Face and didn't know who refined it. He thought he could repair it and sell it at a high price. Unfortunately, there was no possibility of repairing it. In addition, his family was not rich. He was reluctant to keep such an expensive mask for his own use, so he could only bear the pain and sell it again.
Although the Thousand Spirits Illusionary Face can block the detection of the cultivator of the God, in the eyes of many casual cultivators, they think that it is not so good. After all, the cultivator of the God is not a living thing that runs around. It is impossible to have personal contact in a lifetime, let alone cause social resentment and need to change one's appearance to avoid it.
If Wu Weiyang hadn't been interested in the Qianling Phantom's weapon pattern, Wu Weiyang wouldn't have bought it in the first place. After all, there were many magic weapons that could be used to change the appearance of the magical weapon in the world.
Wu Weiyang lowered his eyes and looked at the Thousand Spirits Illusion Face in his hand. It had become brand new. The seven gems were firmly embedded in the peak of the eyebrows, and the burnt black on the edges was much lighter.
After repairing it, it has become a low-level spiritual treasure.
The power of the illusion is stronger, and its concrete manifestation is now harder to detect.
As for the function of the other Thousand Spirits, Wu Weiyang secretly didn't like the feeling of controlling living people for his own use.
She looked at the illusory face of Qianling, pondering slightly, then her eyes suddenly brightened, and she entered the bamboo flute space.
Wu Weiyang went straight to his spiritual stone mine, looked at the jade figurine puppets all over the place, and raised the Thousand Spirits Phantom Face.
There was a rare trace of nervousness in her heart. She recalled the complicated seals in the picture, and after careful consideration, she realized that they should be a kind of restriction. She stood there for a long time to comprehend, and then tried to use the Qianling Phantom.
The spiritual light shot out and covered the faces of the jade figurines under Wu Weiyang's expectant gaze.
The light dissipated, and the jade face glowed with color.
Wu Weiyang got excited before putting on the Thousand Spirits Illusion Mask. In an instant, warm spiritual waves brushed across his face, and several marks flashed in the sea of ​​consciousness.
When the divine consciousness touches the mark, the figure of the jade figurine puppet appears.
Wu Weiyang quickly figured out how to control the jade puppets through the forbidden mark.
It's easy to control only one puppet, but if you want to control dozens or hundreds of puppets, the difficulty will soar.
However, her jade figurine puppet was already equipped with the peering technique. Now she only needs to control the jade figurine puppet that has conscious actions to make all the puppets move together.
Wu Weiyang played with excitement for a long time.
It's a pity that the jade figurine puppets are made for mining, so it is difficult to transform them into combat puppets.
Thinking of this, Wu Weiyang found Dong Niang, who was happily collecting nectar in the flower field.
I almost forgot, Dong Niang’s fur has almost grown.
Wu Weiyang's eyes were fiery, Dong Niang turned around in confusion, and was caught.
